series.name: College St northbound (citybound)
series.evidence: Counter 356 replaced 330 at the same site on 2025-10-02; on that overlap day both counted the same bikes (North 780 vs 813, AM peak 435 vs 456), so 356 reads about 4% higher, which is comparable; late-Sep 2025 weekdays on 330 (~840) match early-Oct weekdays on 356 (~800-900).

series.name: College St southbound
series.evidence: Same replacement; on 2025-10-02 South read 636 on 330 vs 673 on 356 (PM peak 298 vs 323), about 6% higher, comparable; overlap day taken from 330 only because both counted the same bikes.

summary: Counter 330 reported every slot doubled (all counts even, twice the later level) from the start on 2024-01-05 to 2024-05-19; the automatic halving covers exactly that span and is correct. The zero_outage fixes (Jan, Jun and Sep-Oct 2024, Feb 2025, 2025-10-23) cover real multi-day dead periods, and the low 2024-06-22 is rain seen at neighbouring sites too, so no changes are needed. Counter 356 replaced 330 on 2025-10-02 and a one-day overlap shows it reads within about 5% of 330, so each direction becomes one continuous series.
